# web-draw

> web-draw is SCTY's fork of ExcaliDash, a self-hosted workspace for Excalidraw drawings with collections, live collaboration, sharing and version history. This fork adds a Copilot that draws on the canvas from your voice or from pasted Markdown or code. Made by SCTY Lab.

- Source: https://github.com/SCTY-Inc/web-draw (LGPL-3.0). Upstream: https://github.com/ZimengXiong/ExcaliDash
- Storage: one SQLite database by default, with uploaded images beside it. Drawings export as `.excalidraw` files.
- Copilot: needs a build from this repository with `VITE_COPILOT_ENABLED=true` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` on the backend. Compose allows the model only flowchart, sequence and class Mermaid diagrams. Voice sessions end after three idle minutes.
- The app at https://draw.scty.org/ needs sign-in.

## Quickstart

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SCTY-Inc/web-draw.git
cd web-draw
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

Open http://localhost:6767. These commands run the published upstream ExcaliDash images, without the Copilot. The compose file publishes port 6767 on every network interface, so put it behind a firewall or a proxy.
